/* CGFK$CHK_SC_USERS_USR_SUT_FK */
PROCEDURE CGFK$CHK_SC_USERS_USR_SUT_FK(
 P_USR_TYPE_NAME IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :SC_USERS.USR_TYPE_NAME. */
 ,P_USR_TYPE IN NUMBER ) IS /* Value in Item :SC_USERS.USR_TYPE. */
/* Validate foreign key value/query lookup data. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT SUT.USR_TYPE_NAME
 FROM SC_USER_TYPES SUT
 WHERE SUT.USR_TYPE_CD = P_USR_TYPE;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO P_USR_TYPE_NAME;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

/* CGFK$CHK_SC_USERS_USR_SC_USR_C */

 P_CLASS_ANAME IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :SC_USERS.CLASS_ANAME. */
 ,P_CLASS_CD IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :SC_USERS.CLASS_CD. */
 ,P_USR_TYPE IN NUMBER ) IS /* Value in Item :SC_USERS.USR_TYPE. */
/* Validate foreign key value/query lookup data. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT SC_USR_CLS.CLASS_ANAME
 FROM SC_USER_CLASS SC_USR_CLS
 WHERE SC_USR_CLS.USR_TYPE_CD = P_USR_TYPE
 AND (SC_USR_CLS.CLASS_CD = P_CLASS_CD OR
 (SC_USR_CLS.CLASS_CD IS NULL AND
 P_CLASS_CD IS NULL ));
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO P_CLASS_ANAME;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PRINT_CHECK_VAL IS
pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER ; 
 H_DATE DATE ;
 V_VAL VARCHAR2(100);
 Y NUMBER (7);
 X NUMBER (7);
G_DATE DATE;
P_CURR_PORT_CD NUMBER ;
P_TRF_CD VARCHAR2(10);
RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
------------------------------------
IF :ACTIVITY=1 AND :NOT_ENTR_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN
HIJDATE.TO_GREG(:NOT_ENTR_DATE,G_DATE);
ELSIF :ACTIVITY=2 AND :NOT_ACTIVITY_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN
HIJDATE.TO_GREG(:NOT_ACTIVITY_DATE,G_DATE);
ELSIF :ACTIVITY=3 AND :ACTIVITY_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN
 HIJDATE.TO_GREG(:ACTIVITY_DATE,G_DATE);
ELSE
 G_DATE:=NULL;
END IF; 
IF :ACTIVITY=1 THEN

SELECT COUNT( * ) /*(SC_USERS.USER_ID) */

INTO V_COUNT
FROM SD_PORTS, 
SC_USERS, 
SC_USER_DTLS,
SC_USER_CLASS

WHERE 
--:ACTIVITY=1 
 (SC_USERS.PORT_CD=:P_PORT_CD OR :P_PORT_CD IS NULL)
 AND (SC_USER_DTLS.LAST_LOGIN <=G_DATE OR SC_USER_DTLS.LAST_LOGIN IS NULL)
 AND SD_PORTS.PORT_CD=SC_USERS.PORT_CD 
 AND SC_USERS.PORT_CD=SC_USER_DTLS.PORT_CD(+) 
 AND SC_USERS.USER_ID=SC_USER_DTLS.USER_ID(+) 
 AND SC_USERS.CLASS_CD=SC_USER_CLASS.CLASS_CD 
 AND SC_USERS.USR_TYPE_CD=SC_USER_CLASS.USR_TYPE_CD(+)
 AND ( SC_USERS.CLASS_CD=:CLASS_CD OR :CLASS_CD IS NULL)
 AND (SC_USERS.USR_TYPE_CD=:USR_TYPE OR :USR_TYPE IS NULL)
 --xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ADDED BY ALI.J IN 11/27/2006 xxx
 and (((:USER_LOCKED_STAATS = 0)and(SC_USERS.USR_LOCKED =:USER_LOCKED_STAATS))or(:USER_LOCKED_STAATS != 0));
 --xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
 
--message('v_count '||v_count);
--ooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo
ELSIF:ACTIVITY=2 THEN
SELECT COUNT(*)

INTO V_COUNT

FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS AC, 
 SC_USER_DTLS UD,
 SC_USERS U,
 SD_PORTS P,
 SC_USER_CLASS

 WHERE 
--:ACTIVITY=2 AND
 UD.PORT_CD = P.PORT_CD
 AND UD.USER_ID = U.USER_ID
 AND UD.PORT_CD = U.PORT_CD
 AND UD.USER_ID=AC.USER_ID(+)
 AND UD.PORT_CD=AC.PORT_CD(+)
 -- AND AC.ACTVY_DATE(+) BETWEEN UD.LAST_LOGIN AND UD.LAST_LOGOUT
 AND AC.ACTVY_DATE IS NULL
 AND (UD.LAST_LOGIN >= G_DATE OR G_DATE IS NULL)
 --AND UD.LAST_LOGIN>='10/10/2004'
 --ORDER BY UD.USER_ID
AND (UD.PORT_CD= :P_PORT_CD OR :P_PORT_CD IS NULL)
--

AND (SC_USER_CLASS.CLASS_CD=:CLASS_CD OR :CLASS_CD IS NULL)

AND U.CLASS_CD=SC_USER_CLASS.CLASS_CD
AND U.USR_TYPE_CD=SC_USER_CLASS.USR_TYPE_CD(+)
AND (U.USR_TYPE_CD=:USR_TYPE OR :USR_TYPE IS NULL )
 --xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ADDED BY ALI.J IN 11/27/2006 xxx
 and (((:USER_LOCKED_STAATS = 0)and(U.USR_LOCKED =:USER_LOCKED_STAATS))or(:USER_LOCKED_STAATS != 0));
 --xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
/**************************لديهم نشاط*/
ELSIF:ACTIVITY=3 THEN
SELECT COUNT(*)

INTO V_COUNT

FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS AC, 
 SC_USER_DTLS UD,
 SC_USERS U,
 SD_PORTS P,
 SC_USER_CLASS

 WHERE 
--:ACTIVITY=2 AND
 UD.PORT_CD = P.PORT_CD
 AND UD.USER_ID = U.USER_ID
 AND UD.PORT_CD = U.PORT_CD
 AND UD.USER_ID=AC.USER_ID(+)
 AND UD.PORT_CD=AC.PORT_CD(+)
 -- AND AC.ACTVY_DATE(+) BETWEEN UD.LAST_LOGIN AND UD.LAST_LOGOUT
 AND AC.ACTVY_DATE IS NOT NULL
 AND (UD.LAST_LOGIN >= G_DATE OR G_DATE IS NULL)
 --AND UD.LAST_LOGIN>='10/10/2004'
 --ORDER BY UD.USER_ID
AND (UD.PORT_CD= :P_PORT_CD OR :P_PORT_CD IS NULL)
--

AND (SC_USER_CLASS.CLASS_CD=:CLASS_CD OR :CLASS_CD IS NULL)

AND U.CLASS_CD=SC_USER_CLASS.CLASS_CD
AND U.USR_TYPE_CD=SC_USER_CLASS.USR_TYPE_CD(+)
AND (U.USR_TYPE_CD=:USR_TYPE OR :USR_TYPE IS NULL)
 --xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ADDED BY ALI.J IN 11/27/2006 xxx
 and (((:USER_LOCKED_STAATS = 0)and(U.USR_LOCKED =:USER_LOCKED_STAATS))or(:USER_LOCKED_STAATS != 0));
 --xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx


-- message('v_count '||v_count);
END IF;
-------

IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN

-- message('v_count '||v_count); 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata');
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id );
 END IF;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.p_port_type);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'NOT_ENTR_DATE',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:NOT_ENTR_DATE,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'NOT_ACTIVITY_DATE',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:NOT_ACTIVITY_DATE,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'ACTIVITY_DATE',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:ACTIVITY_DATE,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 ----ADD
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'GDATE',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(G_DATE,'DD-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'ACTIVITY',TEXT_PARAMETER,:ACTIVITY);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_FINAL_TARIFF_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,P_TRF_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.p_REPORT_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'CLASS_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER, :CLASS_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'CLASS_ANAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :CLASS_ANAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'USR_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER, :USR_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'SYSTEM_DATE',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:SYSTEM_DATE,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 ---
 --xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ADDED BY ALI.J IN 26/11/2006 xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
 if :USER_LOCKED_STAATS = 0 then
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_user_locked',TEXT_PARAMETER,0);
 ELSIf :USER_LOCKED_STAATS =2 then
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_user_locked',TEXT_PARAMETER,1);
 end if;
 --xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
 
 ---
 --:TTT:=V_COUNT;
 --MESSAGE(:TTT);
 -- 
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 

ELSE
-- message('v_count '||v_count);
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 100,'ERROR');

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

END ;
